summary.en: The trace sound: the diagram bed (soft keys, 92–108 BPM), a pluck per fuse, ticks per count, a whoosh round each loop, a glitch as an unseen word resolves.
summary.zh: trace 的声音：diagram 音乐床（柔和键盘，92–108 BPM），每次融合一声拨弦，每次计数嘀嗒，循环一阵风声，没见过的词解析时一点电流声。

fits: Explainers of a running mechanism; quiet, legible films.
notFor: Launch films with a big climax.

intent.en: A quiet bed leaves room to think; each step of the run has its own small sound.
intent.zh: 安静的音乐床给思考留空间；运行的每一步都有自己的小声音。

content.en: A film on the arc of its style; event kinds from the scenes' plans.
content.zh: 按其风格骨架编排的片子；事件种类来自各场景的 plan。

fits.zh: 运行中的机制讲解；安静、易读的片子。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; its presets and cues are read off the template's score.mjs (card, Differs from upstream)
